topics.label: Introduction to cancer hallmarks and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture objectives, background, and framework for examining the hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Growth signaling pathways and deregulation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in key signaling cascades, including Wnt/beta-catenin and receptor tyrosine kinase pathways, drive growth signal independence and sustained cell proliferation.

topics.label: Differentiation block in hematopoietic and epithelial cancers
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how a block to terminal differentiation prevents cells from exiting the cell cycle and contributes to malignancy in blood and intestinal tissues.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis and p53-Bcl-2 pathway regulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through mutations in p53 and imbalance among Bcl-2 family proteins.

topics.label: Telomere regulation, senescence bypass, and p53-mediated stress responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the limits of cellular replication, how cancer cells reactivate telomerase to achieve immortality, and how p53 mediates stress responses to maintain genome integrity.

topics.label: Metabolic rewiring and oncometabolites in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics transition to non-autonomous hallmarks and investigate how cancer cells alter their metabolism through aerobic glycolysis, Krebs cycle enzyme mutations, and epigenetic modification.

topics.label: Angiogenesis and tumor vascularization
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the angiogenic switch and how tumors stimulate new blood vessel growth to sustain nutrient and oxygen delivery.

topics.label: Mechanisms, detection, and genomics of tumor metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the metastatic cascade, the monitoring of circulating tumor cells, metastatic inefficiency, and the genomic characteristics of secondary tumors.

topics.label: Summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding review of the hallmarks and closing housekeeping remarks.
